payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'comparing' (a ten-destination comparison for a 150k+ AUD audience), which services.md routes to a Wedded Concierge consultation as primary, with the brief's service_link /wonderland-concierge. All four tracked links already exist once each with utm_medium=content and the slug as campaign, primary before secondary, every concierge anchor reads 'Wedded Concierge', and both targets are in the link map, so no link, marker or copy is added and 08-final.md is untouched. The primary sits at the question peak, straight after the at-a-glance table; the secondary follows the Advisor line and the venue questions on deposits, contracts and access; the closing invites date, guests and privacy needs. Panel cta_reactions: three 'maybe' (funding_parent, planner_couple, sceptic) and two 'no' (search_visitor, uhnw), weighted enquiry 2.0. Of what the 'maybe' readers want first, the post now carries everything it can before the CTAs (deposit and contract questions to the venue, access and medical questions, a plain line on what Wedded Concierge is). The rest (fee model, commissions, deposits held, a first phone call, on-the-day contact, scale and confidentiality) are deferred business answers that belong on /wonderland-concierge and are logged for the run report. Subtexts use only brand-facts 'Claims we can make' and avoid fee, price and availability wording. Backlog suggestion: a 'destination weddings by month' or November weather-and-questions checklist magnet (the ten venue question sets in one printable) would suit this post; none is known to exist in the link map (exists: false, not placed). A consented real November wedding page, asked for by planner_couple and sceptic, would also lift enquiry and is already a VERIFY item at panel stage.
